import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
from rakl.engineering_doctor_probes import ProbeContext, build_doctor, render_report, worst_status
from rakl.engineering_ops import BackupManifest, ProbeStatus

project, manifest_path, now, workflow_db = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), Path(sys.argv[4])
manifest_raw = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
records = sorted((project / ".rakl" / "records").glob("*.json"))
digests = tuple(json.loads(p.read_text())["payload_sha256"] for p in records)
ctx = ProbeContext(
    now=now,
    object_store_root=project / ".rakl" / "store" / "sha256",
    expected_object_digests=digests,
    workflow_db_path=workflow_db,
    backup_manifest=BackupManifest(manifest_raw["backup_id"], manifest_raw["created_at"],
                                   manifest_raw["entries"], manifest_raw["manifest_digest"]),
    backup_restore_root=project,
    backup_max_age_seconds=86400,
    stored_status={"project_id": "orion-drill", "freshness": "FRESH",
                   "hard_gates": {"payload_integrity": "PASS"}},
)
results = build_doctor(ctx).run()
print(render_report(results))
overall = worst_status(results)
# CANNOT_CHECK gets its own code: "could not check" must never exit 0 alongside "checked and fine"
raise SystemExit({ProbeStatus.FAIL: 1, ProbeStatus.CANNOT_CHECK: 3}.get(overall, 0))
